blocks.content: Create a program to divide N chocolates among M children.

items: Get an integer value for the number of chocolates and assign it to the chocolates variable.
Get an integer input for the number of children and assign it to the children variable.
Find the number of chocolate each child gets after division and print it.
Find the number of remaining chocolates and print it.

blocks.content: Assumption: The number of chocolates will always be greater than the number of children.
